panels.title: Spend: reservations vs settled
panels.description: metric not yet emitted: mitig8it_remediation_spend_reserved_usd_total and mitig8it_remediation_spend_settled_usd_total do not exist yet. Reservation minus settled is the drift that reconciliation must clear; a persistent gap means orphan reservations, not saved money.

panels.title: Unsettled spend reservations
panels.description: metric not yet emitted: mitig8it_remediation_spend_reserved_usd_total and mitig8it_remediation_spend_settled_usd_total do not exist yet.

panels.title: Budget stops
panels.description: metric not yet emitted: mitig8it_remediation_budget_stops_total does not exist yet. A non-zero value means the hard spend ceiling refused work, which is correct behaviour and not an outage.

panels.title: Ambiguous GitHub writes awaiting reconciliation
panels.description: Emitted: action transitions into the reconciling state. Any non-zero value blocks the action until reconciliation records applied, not_applied, or unresolved.

panels.title: Stale-head rejections
panels.description: metric not yet emitted: mitig8it_remediation_github_stale_head_rejections_total does not exist yet. A rejection is the expected-head guard working; a sudden rise usually means a busy PR, not a defect.

panels.title: Oldest unreconciled GitHub mutation age
panels.description: metric not yet emitted: mitig8it_remediation_reconciliation_age_seconds does not exist yet. The operational objective is to reconcile within 5 minutes.

panels.title: Evaluation suite pass rate
panels.description: metric not yet emitted: mitig8it_remediation_evaluation_suite_pass_ratio does not exist yet. The release evaluator writes a JSON report; nothing publishes it to Prometheus. A pass rate from the seed or scripted-provider suite is a pipeline-integrity signal, not repair quality.
